video_title: Darryn Peterson AMAZING NBA Scouts Ahead Of BLOCKBUSTER Matchup With AJ Dybantsa

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson's impressive performance in Salt Lake City Summer League
quotes.excerpt: Darryn Peterson, my god, extraordinarily impressive, the last two games he's played.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I think we will be talking about the Jazz a lot more and we're not going to be talking about their tanking moves. Darryn Peterson, my god, extraordinarily impressive, the last two games he's played. I don't think he's playing to play tonight against the Thunder, so I think this will be it for Salt Lake.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim McMahon
text_blocks.text: We talked about them a lot last year. Jazz fans will enjoy our Jazz coverage a lot more.

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson's high potential as a future scoring leader
quotes.excerpt: There's a reason why teams have taken the strategic route that the Jazz did in recent years.
quotes.quote: There's a reason why teams have taken the strategic route that the Jazz did in recent years, and it's to get a dude. And Darryn Peterson is a D-O-O-D. I'm sitting here watching these games with scouts, grizzled scouts who have been in the league for 20, 25, 30 years. They're raving about this kid. They're telling me they think he has scoring leader type of potential. They're raving about the way that he's directing traffic, the reads that he's making, the poise he's playing with, the passes that he's making.

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson's impressive playmaking and composure against strong competition
quotes.excerpt: He had a 12-assist, two-turnover performance against the Grizzlies and he's being guarded a lot by Cedric Coward.
quotes.quote: He had a 12-assist, two-turnover performance against the Grizzlies and he's being guarded a lot by Cedric Coward. It wasn't like it was a weak Summer League lineup that the Grizzlies are throwing out there. Coward is a very good wing defender already in the NBA, and Peterson was completely unbothered by that. 25 points on 15 shots, 12 assists, and a lot of the assists are where he's manipulating the defense and making the reads. He's making tough passes that only the really good players can make.

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyonte George's active involvement in team development and workouts
quotes.excerpt: Just how much of an investment Keyonte George in particular has made in trying to develop a relationship.
quotes.quote: Something else that's been very interesting is just how much of an investment Keyonte George in particular has made in trying to develop a relationship and partnership. He's been at all the workouts and all the practices. You've got several Jazz players sitting front row at the games. Keyonte George, Isaiah Collier, Brice Sensabaugh, they were reacting. I saw Keyonte George on his feet after seeing some of these baskets.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The lack of salary for Summer League coaches
quotes.excerpt: What do you think the salary for a Summer League coach is? You think it's worth his time?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: What do you think the salary for a Summer League coach is? You think it's worth his time?

text_blocks.speaker: Tim McMahon
text_blocks.text: Zero is what it is here. You get per diem, that's basically what you get.

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Optimism regarding a potential contract extension for Keyonte George
quotes.excerpt: I was informed that, hey, there's a little bit more optimism of that possibly happening.
quotes.quote: I've been telling you I didn't think that an extension would be forthcoming for Keyonte George. I was informed that, hey, there's a little bit more optimism of that possibly happening than there had been even a week or two ago. There's a chance that there could be a meeting in the middle.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer's impressive three-point shooting in Summer League
quotes.excerpt: The thing that has impressed me for Boozer this week, McMahon, is how many threes he's hitting.
quotes.quote: It was sort of a big game for Cameron Boozer, who was drafted a pick behind him. And by the way, Boozer, you know the thing that has impressed me for Boozer this week, McMahon, is how many threes he's hitting. He hit four out of five. I think he's hit maybe seven in the two games.

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer's potential as a high-level offensive player
quotes.excerpt: His three-point shot looks really good. He's hit a couple tough turnarounds off the dribble.
quotes.quote: His three-point shot looks really good. He's hit a couple tough turnarounds off the dribble. Boozer's going to be a really, really good offensive player.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson's competitive edge in the matchup against Cameron Boozer
quotes.excerpt: I knew he would feel a certain way because I was picked right in front of him.
quotes.quote: He was asked about the matchup, playing against Boozer. And he's, you know, Peterson, I'm summarizing what he said, that, you know, he's like, I knew he would feel a certain way because I was picked right in front of him. And he goes, I feel a certain way because he was picked right behind me. And basically, and he smiled when he said it, but I could see in his eyes that there was a little bit of edge. Basically he was saying, you know, when there's a guy picked next to me, like there's going to be edge in that game.

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson's future as a high-volume scorer in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: He will step into the league as a big-time scorer.
quotes.quote: He will step into the league as a big-time scorer. I think it's a really good situation that he's going to be part of one of the more dynamic backcourts in the league where he will have the ball in his hands a lot, but it's not like the weight of the world's on his shoulders. And there's going to be good spacing. Nurkic is an elite screener, maybe the best screener in the league, right up there.

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Will Hardy's hands-on coaching approach and defensive focus
quotes.excerpt: Will is basically saying, it's on me to earn his trust, but I'm going to be coaching him hard.
quotes.quote: Will is basically saying, it's on me to earn his trust, but I'm going to be coaching him hard, including a film session the morning after, going play-by-play through his Summer League debut. And I asked like what were you really emphasizing? And he said there's a lot of stuff on the defensive end. And they've got this call in their, you know, in their language, a defensive call, Raven. And it's because Will Hardy grew up a Ravens fan. It's a shout-out to Ed Reed.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson's lack of familiarity with Ed Reed
quotes.excerpt: That's disappointing because his brother is a star football player.
quotes.quote: That's disappointing because his brother is a star football player.

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson's fandom for the Cincinnati Bengals
quotes.excerpt: He said I grew up a Bengals fan.
quotes.quote: He said I grew up a Bengals fan. Ed Reed had a ton of picks against the Bengals, like I'm sure you know that. But then, Windhorst, I looked it up. This kid was five years old when Ed Reed played his last down for the Baltimore Ravens.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Windhorst's disapproval of the Cleveland Browns as a team choice
quotes.excerpt: If I was raising a child in Northeast Ohio, I wouldn't let him be a Browns fan either.
quotes.quote: If I was raising a child in Northeast Ohio, I wouldn't let him be a Browns fan either. I would definitely say, I would have said Steelers, but I'll go with Bengals. Bengals are a little harder to root for. The organization, the quality of the Steelers organization is...

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The relative difficulty of rooting for the Bengals versus the Steelers
quotes.excerpt: I think the Bengals were harder to root for.
quotes.quote: I think the Bengals were harder to root for. No, they're harder than the Steelers. Like I was, I would, if I was raising my son in Northeast Ohio, I would push him away from the Browns towards the Steelers.
